sections.text:
حَشد ل 
مضخة إدواردز

Preliminary precautions prior to
assembly (all models)

Be sure all parts are clean and free of grease, metal chips and that all 
 gasket material remove from machined surfaces. Using a wire brush, buff 
 threads on packing (19A. and 19B) and adjusting nuts (12)

Using either a wire brush or round hole brush, remove any packing from 
 threaded packing gland holes

After cleaning parts, use a fine flat file, and keeping the file surface 
 flat with machir surfaces, gently remove any burrs. Remove also any burrs on 
 edges of pump parts, es cially end covers (2. and 5.) and end cases (15.)

With 10 grit emery paper, remove any build up on counterbore surfaces of 
 end ca (15.)

Using the same type of paper as in step 4 remove foreign build up on the 
 ins diameter of pump body (25). Be sure to deburr all edges using 100 grit 
 emery pap
Reassemble pump from drive end of pump as viewed from driver.

sections.text: Figure 1
تجميع المضخة

Review rotation chart. (note : suction port is stamped "suction" discharge 
 port is stamped "discharge"

Install two liner segments (21) into pump body (25) Note : both liner 
 segments should have "S" marked on them these go nearest to the suction of the 
 pump. Note : there are holes drilled on suction side of liners. This side of 
 the liner must always go toward the suction marked side of the body

Install rotor / shaft (23) into pump so that the threaded end is away from 
 drive end

Install rotor / drive shaft (22) into pump so that the threaded end of 
 shaft is away from drive end. Be sure the drive shaft is located in the proper 
 position. See rotation chart (page 21)

Position the two remaining liner segments (21) into the pump body in the 
 same manner as step 2: and noting the suction hole position as in step 2 is 
 facing the suction side of the pump

Apply a thin film of grease on the gasket surface of the pump body and 
 install the body gaskets (20) to both sides

Apply a thin film of oil to packing area and seal area on the shaft. This 
 will provide initial lubrication to both packing and grease seals

باستخدام درجة الخشنة

 مهاوي (22 و 23)

Clean excess compound 
 away and wipe both the male and female taper 
 half clean with a clean rag and suitable solvent. (Do not use oil based 
 solvent)

Install timing gear 
 (10) onto idler shaft (23) by tapping gear onto shaft with a 
 hollow sleeve. Taper should hold gear on tight.

Install timing gear nut 
 (8) onto the threaded end (23) of the idler shaft and 
 tighten to approximately 175 # ft. torque.

Run a piece of 
 .006/.010 shim stock between rotors from the discharge port for clearance. Leave shim stock between rotors for 
 clearance adjustment.

Set timing gear (10) 
 loosely onto the drive shaft (22)

Rotate timing gear in 
 the direction of rotation slightly while holding gear (10) on 
 the drive shaft being careful that the shim stock remains in between 
 rotors. Make 
 sure that the timing gear on the drive shaft is touching or driving the 
 timing gear on the idler shaft.

Tap timing gear onto 
 drive shaft tapered seat and secure with timing gear 
 nut (8) as in step D
 Note : 
 use a piece of brass or hardwood between timing gear teeth to prevent 
 rotation when tightening timing gear nuts.

Remove shim stock from 
 pump compartment. Pump should turn freely and 
 timing gear on the drive shaft should be driving the timing gear on the 
 idler shaft

sections.text: Grease the face of endcase # 2 (15) and install cover gasket (4)
Install timing gear cover (2) with bolts (3) (5/16" x 3/4" NC)
قم بتشحيم وجه العلبة النهائية رقم 1 (15) وقم بتركيب حشية الغطاء (4)

Install front seal (7) into front cover (5) flush with the cover face. Be 
 sure that the lip side of the seal faces outward (toward the coupling)

قم بتركيب غطاء العلبة الأمامية (5) وثبته بالمسامير (3) (5/16 بوصة × 
 3/4 "مسامير غطاء NC)

Fill end cover (2) with lubricant (Chevron industrial grease - medium for 
 pumps) to designated levels (approximately 1/2 
 full)
 Note : During initial break-in excess pressure can build up in the endcases 
 which will cause excess grease to run out of the zerk fitting

After assembly is complete, the packing gland adjustment should be 
 performed during initial break-in. Tightening of packing glands should be done 
 with caution. The packing nuts (19A & 19B) should not be over-tightened. 
 Tighten packing nuts only enough to prevent excessive lrakage. A few droplets 
 of pump age is all that should appear when pump is in operation.
ملحوظة : When pump is not in operation, and suction-pressure is present on the 
 suction side of the pump, excess leakage might appear through packing glands, 
 do not tighten packing glands. This will cause excess wear and damage to 
 packing glands and pump shafts.
 A shut-off valve should be installed on the suction side to eliminate pressure 
 against the packing glands when not in operation to prevent the possibility of 
 over-tightening the packing

After assembly is complete, the packing gland adjustment should be 
 performed during initial break-in. Tightening of packing glands should be done 
 with caution. The packing nuts (19A & 19B) should not be over-tightened. 
 Tighten packing nuts only enough to prevent excessive lrakage. A few droplets 
 of pump age is all that should appear when pump is in operation.
ملحوظة : When pump is not in operation, and suction-pressure is present on the 
 suction side of the pump, excess leakage might appear through packing glands, 
 do not tighten packing glands. This will cause excess wear and damage to 
 packing glands and pump shafts.
 A shut-off valve should be installed on the suction side to eliminate pressure 
 against the packing glands when not in operation to prevent the possibility of 
 over-tightening the packing
